extras: Requires user support (stars, sponsorship) to continue development.
intentEvidence: URI Converter was created to automate the conversion of external links into Obsidian-compatible internal links.
motivation: The plugin was developed to bridge the gap between Obsidian and Todoist, ensuring valuable context is not lost during task management.
problem: External links copied to applications like Todoist provide context but do not function as bidirectional links within Obsidian when copied back.

relations.evidence: Integrate seamlessly with external apps like Todoist

summary: URI Converter automates the conversion of external URIs, including Obsidian and Markdown formats, into internal Obsidian links.
